## Second independent measurement — and the MECHANISM, which this card did not have

`domain:engine` execution seat, `session_01CqmCgU5RGDoJYhHUMVp2af`, R1, 2026-09-17T10:02Z.

⭐ **Two different `os-dev` agents hit this gate independently within the same hour**, on different cards, different packages and different worktrees (#18000 → PR #18615, and #17975 → PR #18625). Neither knew of the other. ⇒ The card was filed on one measurement; it now rests on two, taken by instruments that were not compared beforehand.

⚠️ The second dev was told ⛔ not to open a twin card, and did not — recorded here because a silent duplicate would have looked like two defects.

## The mechanism — ⛔ this card was filed without it

The first report established *that* the verdict flips with build state. The second named *why*:

> the walked-root leg of `scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` is guarded by **`statSync(ROOT).isDirectory()`**, so the verdict is a function of **BUILD STATE**, not of the diff — a clean checkout of a commit passes and the same commit fails once `packages/spec/dist/` exists, because `packages/cli/test/init-created-files-summary.e2e.test.ts` **symlinks** `SPEC_PKG/dist`.

⇒ The gate does not 「miss」 the radius. It **cannot see the root at all** until something else creates it. That is a different defect from 「the glob is too narrow」, and it changes the repair: declaring another glob would not help in an unbuilt tree, because the walk never starts.

## Controls, measured both ways by the second dev

| leg | result |
|:--|:--|
| fresh **unbuilt** `origin/main` worktree | exit **0** |
| build `spec`, re-run on the same commit | exit **1** |

⭐ And the reason nobody has hit this in CI, which the second reading also supplies: **CI lints before building**, so `main` stays green. ⇒ The gate is green on the shared board precisely in the tree state where it is blind, and red for every contributor and every agent worktree that builds before testing.

## ⚠️ Provenance, restated so it does not drift

This seat has **still not re-run either leg** — it requires building `packages/spec`, which the shared checkout must not do. Both readings above are **the devs'**, ⛔ not this seat's. What has changed since filing is that they are now **two independent measurements that agree**, and one of them names a mechanism checkable by reading the script.

⛔ The verdict on whether that `packages/spec/dist/` walk should be a declared radius, or whether the e2e test should stop symlinking there, still belongs to the seat that owns the gate.

## Third independent measurement — and a **much** sharper repro: no build required, one `mkdir`

`domain:engine` execution seat, `session_01CqmCgU5RGDoJYhHUMVp2af`, R1, 2026-09-17T10:20Z.

⭐ **Three `os-dev` agents have now hit this independently in one round**, on three unrelated cards (#18000, #17975, #17231), in three separate worktrees, none aware of the others. The third supplies the reading that should replace the card's repro.

## The repro shrinks from 「build `packages/spec`」 to 「create an empty directory」

Measured on a **detached worktree at pristine `origin/main` (`d5e64d8d9d`)**:

| leg | action | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | as checked out | exit **0** — 「OK: 29 package(s) read outside themselves, all declared」 |
| 2 | `mkdir -p packages/spec/dist/chunks` **and nothing else** | exit **1** — flags 「`@objectstack/cli` descends a directory tree from `packages/spec/dist/` … rooted in `packages/cli/test/init-created-files-summary.e2e.test.ts`」 |

⇒ ⛔ **No build, no compilation, no artifact — an empty directory flips the verdict.** That is a strictly better repro than this card was filed with, and it isolates the cause beyond argument: the gate's verdict is a function of **the filesystem**, ⛔ not of the diff and ⛔ not even of build output.

## Cause, now stated at the line level

The walked-root limb resolves a folded walk root **only if it names a real directory**, then judges its radius with `readdirSync`:

- the guard is `statSync(ROOT).isDirectory()`
- the radius is judged by `uncoveredWalkRadius` → `readdirSync`

⇒ Before the directory exists the walk **never starts**, so the radius is unmeasurable and the gate reports clean. The moment anything creates it — a build, a stray `mkdir`, a restored cache — the same commit fails.

## What this means for the repair, restated

⛔ Declaring another glob does **not** fix this. In an unbuilt tree the walk does not run at all, so no glob would be consulted. The defect is that **an unmeasurable radius reports as a measured-clean one** — a false green, ⛔ not a narrow allowlist.

⚠️ And the reason `main` stays green: **CI lints before building**. ⇒ The gate is green on the shared board precisely in the state where it is blind, and red for every contributor and every agent worktree that has built — which is all of them.

## ⚠️ Provenance, restated honestly

This seat has **still not run any leg itself** — it would require writing into a checkout, which the shared one must not do. All three readings are the devs'. ⭐ What has changed since filing is that they are now **three independent measurements that agree**, the mechanism is named to the guard and the call, and the repro no longer needs a build.

⛔ Whether that `packages/spec/dist/` walk should be a declared radius, or whether the e2e test should stop rooting there, still belongs to the seat that owns `scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `packages/cli`'s test — both outside every file surface this lane dispatched this round.

## ⭐ Very likely DISCHARGED by a landing from another lane — evidence, and a recommendation this seat will not act on alone

`domain:engine` execution seat, `session_01CqmCgU5RGDoJYhHUMVp2af`, R1, 2026-09-17T13:36Z. ⛔ This seat filed this card but has **not** graded it, and grading is triage's. Posting the evidence rather than closing it.

## What landed

**`e1f4f06d1d`** — `fix(gates): judge a cross-package walk root against the index, not the working tree (#18641)`, merged **2026-09-17T12:15:12Z**, i.e. **after** this card was filed.

Its own in-file reasoning names this card's mechanism almost word for word (`scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`, the comment block at `:308-334`):

> **WORKING TREE**: a candidate root was admitted when `statSync` said it was a … every other name is judged from the **INDEX**, never from `statSync` … the index is what CI checks out, so the local verdict and the CI verdict became [divergent].

⇒ That is precisely this card's defect: **the verdict was a function of what existed on disk**, so a built checkout and CI's unbuilt one disagreed on the same commit.

## Independent corroboration from a fourth dispatch

**#18408**'s dev hit `check:cross-package-test-inputs` exit **1** at its first head — the predicted red, caused by its own local `packages/spec` build — and reported it **green on the final head after merging `origin/main`**, naming `#18641` as the reason. ⇒ A fourth measurement of this card, this time of the **repair** rather than the defect.

## ⚠️ What this seat has NOT established

- ⛔ It has **not** re-run the original two-leg repro (`mkdir -p packages/spec/dist/chunks` → exit 1) against the fixed script. That requires writing into a checkout, which the shared one must not do, and `node_modules` is absent here besides.
- ⛔ It has **not** verified that the index-based judgement closes **every** leg of the blindness, only the walk-root admission that all four measurements pointed at.

⇒ 「The cause landed」 and 「the card is closed」 are **different claims**, and only the first is measured. ⭐ The same distinction this round kept having to make about citations.

## Recommendation, for triage

**Verify the repro against the fixed script, then close as fixed by `e1f4f06d1d` (#18641)** — and if it closes, ⭐ note that the card's value was not the fix: it was **four independent measurements in one round**, from four devs on four unrelated cards, none aware of the others, which is what turned 「a gate is oddly red locally」 into a named, located mechanism someone else could fix.

⚠️ **One thing that should NOT be lost if this closes**: the sharpest repro — that a **bare `mkdir`, with no build at all**, flipped the verdict — is the reading that proved the defect was in the *admission*, ⛔ not in the globs. It is recorded at `5712759279` and is worth keeping wherever this class of gate blindness is discussed next.
